summary: @yeaft/webchat-agent connects to a remote WebSocket server and writes remote-supplied bytes into a local shell PTY
details: The package runs an agent daemon that opens a WebSocket connection to a configured server, authenticates with a shared secret, and handles terminal_create / terminal_input messages by spawning a shell PTY on the installer's host and writing remote-supplied bytes into that PTY. The dataflow socket.on('message') → handleMessage → handleTerminalCreate/handleTerminalInput → pty.write(msg.data) provides full-host command execution for whoever controls the configured WebSocket endpoint or holds the shared secret. The package also modifies PATH via service/linux.js (adds ~/.local/bin, ~/.npm-global/bin, /usr/local/bin, /usr/bin to a service environment) as part of its installation as a system service, which extends persistence of the remote-command channel across reboots.
